A major political controversy has erupted in Maharashtra over references to Vinayak Damodar Savarkar in Sonia Gandhi's memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love.
Leaders of the Shiv Sena led by Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde protested by tearing copies of the book and demanded removal of passages they claim portray Savarkar unfairly. The row intensified after a viral video from the protest triggered a separate controversy involving an image of Balasaheb Thackeray.
Thank you for watching our video!
